filter_and_transform_beta_headers: filter and transform anthropic beta headers for a given provider based on supported mappings
update_headers_with_filtered_beta: update request headers by filtering and transforming anthropic-beta header values for a provider
update_request_with_filtered_beta: update both request headers and body beta fields based on provider-specific header support
is_beta_header_supported: check if a specific anthropic beta header is supported by a given provider
get_unsupported_headers: get all beta headers that are unsupported by a provider with null mapping values
